decisions.selected: Resolve American-English spelling findings in docs/src/content Markdown.
alternatives: Measure pull-request creation or agent execution
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow explicitly tasks the agent with justified spelling fixes and makes the spellcheck artifact its source of truth.

decisions.selected: All cspell findings from one run-commit documentation snapshot, including a zero-finding healthy snapshot.
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow's deterministic spellcheck job enumerates the concrete spelling work before the conditional agent path.

decisions.selected: Re-run the adoption-pinned cspell configuration at run.sha; key duplicate snapshots as spellcheck:<run SHA>.
decisions.rationale: Commit content reconstructs the same assignment when case and event are null; short-retention artifacts and branches do not.

decisions.selected: Cspell findings in the default-branch commit at the capped cutoff.
decisions.rationale: Absence of each assigned spelling finding in repository content directly measures the intended documentation-quality outcome.

decisions.selected: Seven days after run creation; evidence is capped at that instant.
decisions.rationale: A stable one-week horizon permits repository changes to land without allowing later unrelated changes to alter mature observations.

decisions.selected: Proportion of assigned file-and-word spelling findings no longer flagged, with zero findings scoring 1.
decisions.rationale: The proportion is one direct attainment metric in [0,1] and preserves the assignment denominator.
The parent predates the workflow and its spellcheck configuration, so no comparable pre-adoption measurement exists.

uncertainties.description: Historical archive retrieval or the pinned cspell execution can be unavailable.
uncertainties.mitigation: Return null rather than zero and retry on later report runs.

uncertainties.description: The one-week maturation horizon is a stable contract choice rather than a pre-adoption turnaround estimate.
A finding can disappear through changes not made by this workflow.
uncertainties.mitigation: Report attainment observationally and do not attribute causation.
